The '''destruction of Til''' was a cataclysm that occurred nearly a [[100 BBY/Legends|century]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Til]],<ref name="UAA" /> situated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Til system/Legends|Til system]],<ref name="GG12" /> exploded with little warning, destroying [[Tililix]], a technologically advanced [[Planet/Legends|world]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] it and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tarro]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA" />

Only those Tarro who were off-world at the [[Time/Legends|time]], numbering merely 350 individuals, survived the destruction of Tililix,<ref name="GG12" /> and they did not adopt a new homeworld due to fear that such an undertaking would involve an undesirable [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] process. Those Tarro who lived in other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] speculated that the destruction of Til was possibly caused by a<ref name="UAA" /> secret<ref name="GG12" /> Tarro-constructed [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Til was created by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]] and indirectly mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12" /> The proper name of the event was introduced by the [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''.<ref name="UAA" />
